Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: several large caps show conflicting 1W/1M signals (MSFT, NVDA, NOW) — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

Tech is mixed and concentrated: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%). Sector performance 1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.71% and leadership is narrow, so monitor for follow-through rather than broad rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are mixed-to-soft with limited leadership: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -2.45%), V RECOVERY (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +3.07%), MA RECOVERY (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +1.69%). Sector returns are negative this week and lack the breadth to confirm a risk-on rotation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing clear weakness: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%), NVS BELOW TREND (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%). Sector 1W: -5.60% | 1M: -2.76% — defensive names are not leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy exposure and selective tech winners (e.g., XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%)) while reducing exposure to weak Healthcare and broad Consumer Discretionary names. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and weak sector breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) — bullish news + price confirming; ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) — bullish headlines but price diverging; META ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) — momentum to watch. BEARISH: NVS BELOW TREND (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) — headline-aligned selling; NOW RECOVERY (1W: -8.97% | 1M: +6.07%) — news pressure and short-term risk; AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) — sentiment conflict to monitor.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +8.60%) — only clear sector leader and should be favored for cyclicals. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -5.60% | 1M: -2.76%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -7.00%) — continued underperformance likely without news catalysts.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor NVDA for failure below this week’s low as a trigger for broader tech weakness (NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%)). Watch AMD to hold recent breakout (AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%)) for momentum continuation. Watch XOM support to confirm Energy leadership (XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%)).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMD (-60): negative macro headline vs AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) — sentiment/price divergence. INTC (-50): bearish headlines but INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) — watch for volatility. NVS (-50): bearish headlines align with price — NVS BELOW TREND (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) and at risk near-term.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Energy and a narrow set of tech names are showing relative strength — XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%). Key risk is major 1W/1M divergences among megacaps (MSFT BELOW TREND, NVDA BELOW TREND, NOW RECOVERY) and mixed news sentiment (NVDA/AMD conflict), so monitor for confirmed breadth before expanding conviction.
